segments.text: Take care.

segments.speaker: senior
segments.text: Hello, who is this?

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: Hi, this is Monica from the pharmacy on Cedar Court. I'm calling about a prescription for Betty.

segments.speaker: senior
segments.text: Yes, this is she.

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: Have you heard from your son lately?

segments.speaker: senior
segments.text: He calls Sundays. He's in Denver now, with the airline.

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: Is your knee any better?

segments.speaker: senior
segments.text: Some days. The doctor wants to do the injection again in the spring.

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: Before I go into the medication, can you confirm your date of birth for me?

segments.speaker: senior
segments.text: June second, nineteen thirty nine.

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: Your Medicare Part D plan changed the copay on the cholesterol pill. It's going to be twelve dollars instead of four this time.

segments.speaker: senior
segments.text: She did say she was raising it, yes.

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: There's a generic that would bring it down to six dollars. Want me to switch it?

segments.speaker: senior
segments.text: Yes please, the cheaper one.

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: Got it. Is there anything else I can help with today?

segments.speaker: senior
segments.text: Sorry, my hearing isn't what it was. Say that again?

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: Sure.

segments.speaker: senior
segments.text: Actually, could you check if my eye drops are due?

segments.speaker: senior
segments.text: Oh, before I forget. My neighbor's boy is selling his old car and I told him I'd ask around. Do you know anyone?

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: Of course.

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: Did the furnace get fixed?

segments.speaker: senior
segments.text: The young man came out Tuesday. It was a sensor, thirty dollars.

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: How are you holding up with this heat?

segments.speaker: senior
segments.text: Oh, I keep the fan on and don't go out until evening.

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: Did you get any of that rain last night?

segments.speaker: senior
segments.text: Just a little. The gutters are still holding.

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: Did your daughter make it up for the holiday?

segments.speaker: senior
segments.text: She did, with the kids. The house was a zoo.

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: Is the cat still bossing you around?

segments.speaker: senior
segments.text: Every morning at five. Like clockwork.

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: Is your knee any better?

segments.speaker: senior
segments.text: Some days. The doctor wants to do the injection again in the spring.

segments.speaker: caller
segments.text: Take care now.

segments.speaker: senior
segments.text: Bye now.
